title: Cook kamar ƙwararru: stock, braise, gasa da soya

say: Cook kamar ƙwararru: stock, braise, gasa da soya.
Wannan bidiyon ne don Module 1 na Babban Dafa abinci da Gina Jiki: ƙwararrun dabarun dafa abinci.
Kwararrun masu dafa abinci suna samun sakamako iri ɗaya kowane lokaci saboda sun fahimci abin da zafi, ruwa, mai da lokaci ke yi ga abinci.

say: Kwayoyin cuta suna girma da sauri tsakanin kimanin 5 C zuwa 60 C. Don haka a raba kayan zafi zuwa kwantena marasa zurfi, ajiye su a cikin ruwan sanyi, kuma a firiji cikin sa'o'i 2. Kada a bar hannun jari a kan murhu dare daya.

panel.rule: Kayan lambu mai sanyi a cikin kwantena masu zurfi; firiji cikin awanni 2.

say: Ga misalin aiki. Ifeoma tana rufe kashi 2 na kashin kaji da lita 4 na ruwan sanyi, a zuba 200 g na kayan kamshi, sannan a yi sanyi a hankali na tsawon awanni 3. Tana fitar da kusan lita 3.

card.title: Kaji mai lita 3 da kudin sa

say: Kashin nata ya kai kimanin naira 5,000, kayan kamshi kusan naira dubu daya, gas kuma naira dari takwas.

say: Wato kimanin Naira 6,800, wato kusan Naira 2,267 kowace lita. Ta sanya masa alama, ta yi amfani da shi a cikin kwanaki 3 daga firiji, ko kuma ta daskare shi a cikin jaka 500 ml.

say: Cututtuka masu tauri suna da wadata a cikin collagen. Dogon, mai laushi, zafi mai laushi yana narke shi a cikin gelatin. Da farko a shafa naman ya bushe, saboda rigar nama yana tururi maimakon launin ruwan kasa. Toshe shi cikin batches ba tare da cunkoso ba.

say: Browning yana buƙatar busasshiyar ƙasa da zafi mai zafi, don haka a bushe abinci kuma a bar sarari tsakanin guda. Cunkushe guda ya yi tururi kuma ya zama launin toka.
Mabuɗan Maɓalli Biyar na WHO sun ba da shawarar dafa abinci har sai ya kai 70 C. A bincika mafi ƙanƙanta, nesa da ƙashi, sannan a huta naman.

say: Ruwan 'ya'yan itace masu tsabta alamun taimako ne, amma ba hujja ba ne.

Gawayi yana ba da carbon monoxide, iskar gas da ba za ku iya gani ba ko warin da zai iya kashewa. Kada a taɓa gasa a cikin daki, kicin ko gareji, koda tare da buɗe taga. Kuma a ware danye da dafaffen tire.

say: Man da ke da sanyi sosai yana shiga abinci. Man da ya yi zafi ya fara kona waje. Yawancin soya yana aiki mafi kyau a kimanin 160 zuwa 180 C.
A soya kananan batches, a soya dawa, dankalin turawa da plantain zuwa zinari, ba launin ruwan duhu ba.

panel.heading: Yawan zafin mai da gobarar mai

cards.d: Yawancin soya suna aiki a kimanin 160 zuwa 180 C. Soya ƙananan batches, zinariya ba launin ruwan kasa ba.
Mai bai wuce kashi ɗaya bisa uku na tukunyar ba. An kunna hannu. Kada a bar mai zafi shi kaɗai.
Kada a taba amfani da ruwa. Kashe iskar gas, zamewa murfi ko daskararren bargon wuta a kai. Kada ku ɗauka.

say: Kada a cika tukunya fiye da kashi ɗaya bisa uku da mai. Ci gaba da kunna hannu, rage abinci a hankali, nisanta yara, kuma kada ku bar mai zafi, koda don kiran waya.

say: Idan mai ya kama wuta, kada a zuba ruwa a kai. Tana jefar da mai a ɗakin. Kashe iskar gas idan za ku iya isa gare shi lafiya, zana murfin ƙarfe ko bargon wuta a kan tukunyar, sannan ku bar shi a rufe har sai ya yi sanyi.

say: Don tunawa. Fara haja a cikin ruwan sanyi, ku yi zafi a hankali kuma kada ku gishiri. Ba da tsauri mai tsayi, mai laushi, zafi mai ɗanɗano.
Duba kaza da kifi sun kai aƙalla 70 C. Yi amfani da gawayi a waje kawai. Kuma kada a sanya ruwa a kan wutar mai.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Hannun jari: fara ruwan sanyi, simmer mai laushi, babu gishiri
Yanke mai tauri: tsayi, mai laushi, zafi mai ɗanɗano
Kaza da kifi: akalla 70 C ciki
Gawayi a waje kawai
Wutar mai: rufe shi, kada ruwa

say: Ayyukanku: yi da tsadar haja, ƙwanƙwasa da lokaci mai tsauri, gudanar da gwajin asarar girki, da adana sati guda na bayanan soya mai.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan ku don wannan tsarin
items: Yi, farashi kuma adana haja ɗaya
Braise da lokaci daya m yanke
Guda gwajin asarar girki
Gwajin soya da log ɗin mai
